# Security Policy

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](SECURITY.vi.md)

Security maintenance focuses on the current public `v1.0.x` line.

Do not open a public issue for vulnerabilities involving secrets, unauthorized access, unsafe file handling, or the loopback API security model. Report them privately to `Đăng Khoa <i.am@dangkhoa.dev>`.

The API is designed as a loopback service. This repository does not claim Internet-facing hardening, HA, SLA, or multi-tenant security.
